qc.label_under_test: Dense / gate-leak background unit: the - pole is a weak leak (max 1.52, 11% of tokens above 0.1 of max, 99.6% '-g +u leak') that hums at about 0.1-0.3 of max on most prose. Its feeders ('late' in any sense, lateness words, 'belated', 'little', ambient-it predicates) add only a small bump, so 'too late' / 'too little, too late' does not separate from matched text without lateness; the slightly stronger pockets are clinical-psychology / talking-therapy text (the + pole's topic leaking through) and the headline 'Too Little too Late?'.
